about: Speaking in five (22 Nov 2026): the Writing 'in five' ladder for a Speaking Part. Five moves, one sentence each, the school's frames first (data/drills/speaking/*.json). {X} = what the pupil picks or types. 'q' on a subject is the examiner's question ({X} filled). 'secs' is the target length of the whole answer said aloud.
name: Part 4
how: A Part 4 answer in five: your opinion first, a reason, an example, the other side, then a clear ending. This is where you sound like an adult.

nameAsk.title: What will you talk about?
nameAsk.aim: Pick a topic. The examiner asks what you think about it.

subjects.label: School
subjects.askBad: what people on the other side say

subjects.label: Technology
subjects.askBad: what people on the other side say

subjects.label: Where we live
subjects.askBad: what people on the other side say

slots.label: Your opinion
slots.job: give your opinion in your first sentence
slots.q: Which one gives your opinion first?

ways.t: When it comes to {X}, I personally think that …
As far as I'm concerned, {X} is …

slots.label: Reason
slots.job: support your opinion with a reason

ways.t: The reason I think this is that …

slots.label: Example
slots.job: make it real with an example

ways.t: A good example of this is …

slots.label: The other side
slots.job: show you can see the other side
slots.q: Which one shows the other side?

ways.t: Having said that, some people argue that …
On the other hand, it could be said that …

slots.label: Bring it home
slots.job: end clearly, or hand it to your partner
slots.q: Which one ends your answer clearly?

ways.t: So, on the whole, I'd say …
All in all, I believe that …
That's what I think. What about you?
